function TOTOSLOTORand(min,max){
    return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min;
}

function TOTOSLOTODigits(len){
    let out = "";
    for(let i=0;i<len;i++){
        out += TOTOSLOTORand(0,9);
    }
    return out;
}

function TOTOSLOTOGeneratePrediksi(){
    const pasaran = document.getElementById("rbPasaran").value;
    const tipe = document.getElementById("rbTipe").value;
    const confInput = parseInt(document.getElementById("rbConf").value, 10) || 70;

    const shioList = ["Naga","Tikus","Kerbau","Macan","Kelinci","Ular","Kuda","Kambing","Monyet","Ayam","Anjing","Babi"];
    const shio = shioList[TOTOSLOTORand(0, shioList.length - 1)];

    let len = 4;
    if(tipe === "3D") len = 3;
    if(tipe === "2D") len = 2;

    const mainNumber = TOTOSLOTODigits(len);
    const alt1 = TOTOSLOTODigits(len);
    const alt2 = TOTOSLOTODigits(len);
    const alt3 = TOTOSLOTODigits(len);
    const confFinal = Math.max(50, Math.min(100, confInput + TOTOSLOTORand(-3, 8))) + "%";

    document.getElementById("rbOutPasaran").textContent = pasaran;
    document.getElementById("rbOutTipe").textContent = tipe;
    document.getElementById("rbOutConf").textContent = confFinal;
    document.getElementById("rbOutShio").textContent = shio;
    document.getElementById("rbOutMain").textContent = mainNumber;
    document.getElementById("rbAlt1").textContent = alt1;
    document.getElementById("rbAlt2").textContent = alt2;
    document.getElementById("rbAlt3").textContent = alt3;
}
